meta.status: v3 COMPLETE for the brief: 30 platform entries verified against the cinven.com press-release archive; EV sourced for 21 (14 of 18 core), the other 4 core EVs estimated with method and confidence; equity, revenue, EBITDA and headcount filled where published
meta.fund_notes: Fund attribution from Cinven press releases: Fifth Fund investments numbered 9 (Ufinet, Jun 2014), 10 (NPS), 11 (Premium Credit), 12 (Labco), 13 (Tractel; Labco and Synlab counted together), 14 (ERGO Italia), 16 (Tinsa); Fifth Fund made 17 investments in total, so Kurt Geiger is 15th and Hotelbeds 17th. Sixth Fund: Chryso 4th, JLA 9th, Envirotainer 10th; Jaggaer confirmed Sixth (Cinven 2024 release); Barentz 'last' Sixth Fund deal (unquote); LGC first Seventh Fund deal (PE Insights); TKE and MasMovil Seventh (unquote). SFF: Miller and Compre confirmed by Cinven's SFF close release (Jul 2022, EUR 1.5B).
meta.method: Roster built from the cinven.com WP REST archive of every post Jun 2014 to Dec 2021 (raw/02a/wpjson), cross-checked against cinven.com portfolio pages (raw/02a/companies). Each entry's PR gives date, seller, headcount and sometimes EV or revenue; third-party EVs from unquote, CFNews, Reuters (via Yahoo and Inquirer), Bloomberg (via PYMNTS and Insurance Journal), PE Insights, PEI/Buyouts, Iberian Lawyer (Mergermarket), Real Deals. Where no EV is published a ~ estimate is given with method and confidence and excluded from the 'sourced only' statistics. FX at approximate annual averages listed in meta.fx_rates_used.
